gloss: one after another; in succession; continuously

definitions.gloss: one after another; in succession; continuously
definitions.explanation: Indicates that things happen or appear repeatedly in quick succession, without pause.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}が{次々|つぎつぎ}と{発生|はっせい}した。
{新製品|しんせいひん}が{次々|つぎつぎ}と{発売|はつばい}される。
examples.english: New products are released one after another.

examples.japanese: {お客|おきゃく}さんが{次々|つぎつぎ}と{来店|らいてん}した。
examples.english: Customers came in one after another.

notes:
FORMATION:
{次|つぎ} (next) repeated + と (adverb particle)

The repetition emphasizes continuous succession.

VARIANTS:
・{次々|つぎつぎ}と - standard form
・{次々|つぎつぎ}に - also common
・{次々|つぎつぎ} - can be used without particle

COLLOCATIONS:
・{次々|つぎつぎ}と{起|お}こる - to happen one after another
・{次々|つぎつぎ}と{現|あらわ}れる - to appear successively
・{次々|つぎつぎ}と{倒|たお}れる - to fall one after another

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{続々|ぞくぞく}と - one after another (emphasizes large numbers)
・{立|た}て{続|つづ}けに - in rapid succession
